newsitem.title: USA: PPG unit sues Rodenstock in patent dispute.
newsitem.headline: PPG unit sues Rodenstock in patent dispute.

text.p: Transitions Optical Inc, a unit of PPG Industries, sued Rodenstock USA and Optische Werke Rodenstock alleging they infringed the unit's patent for photosensitive lenses.

In papers filed Moday in U.S. District Court in Delaware, Transitions alleged that its patent for "Photochromic naphthopyrans" is being infringed by Rodenstock's photochromic optical lenses sold under the trademark of SunLight and/or Colormatic.
Rodenstock is a family-owned manufacturer of spectacles headquartered in Munich, Germany.
Transitions, a joint venture with Essilor International SA of France, is based in Pinellas Park, Florida.
A spokesman for Rodenstock, reached in its Danbury, Connecticut office, declined comment.
